feed.title: Glyph releases
feed.subtitle: What changed in each release of Glyph, newest first.

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.162 (breaking)
entry.summary: A ?? on an Option is refused, and glyph fix stops writing inside ${}

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.161 (breaking)
entry.summary: A method that returns undefined when nothing is there is refused, and the Option form is named

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.160 (breaking)
entry.summary: A call that changes an array is written as a mut statement

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.159 (breaking)
entry.summary: An async callback passed where nothing will wait for it is an error

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.158 (breaking)
entry.summary: A lambda parameter without an annotation takes its type from where the lambda is passed

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.157 (breaking)
entry.summary: A value with no text form can't be turned into text by accident

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.156 (breaking)
entry.summary: A lambda parameter has the type you wrote, and is arms narrow

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.155 (breaking)
entry.summary: A SQL query's text has to be fixed when the program is written

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.154 (breaking)
entry.summary: An async call nothing waits for is refused, and task.detach starts work on purpose

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.153 (breaking)
entry.summary: A Record's key type has to match exactly

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.152 (breaking)
entry.summary: A null in an optional field is refused, and the error names the type that accepts it

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.151 (breaking)
entry.summary: A where refinement over a string-literal union is refused, with help built from your own types

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.150 (breaking)
entry.summary: A check refuses a value nested more than 1000 deep instead of crashing

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.149 (breaking)
entry.summary: A statement can no longer start on the line where the one before it ended.

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.148 (breaking)
entry.summary: A map's keys are checked at run time now.

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.147 (breaking)
entry.summary: A check that names a type parameter is now E0304, because a type parameter has no runtime check.

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.146 (breaking)
entry.summary: A { on the line where a statement just ended is now a parse error, E0013.

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.145 (breaking)
entry.summary: is Record<K, V> and is Array<X> now check what the container holds.

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.144
entry.summary: A generic record imported from another module is now judged by the module that declares it, the way an imported record already was.

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.143 (breaking)
entry.summary: An is pattern is now checked the same way T.is(v) is.

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.142 (breaking)
entry.summary: Lint warnings (unused import, unused binding, unreachable code, unreachable module) now show up on a file that has a type error, as long as it parses and its names resolve.

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.141 (breaking)
entry.summary: json.parse now checks a generic record's own fields and a union's variant payloads, and refuses with E0304 when one of them has no runtime check.

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.140
entry.summary: json.parse<Rows> now works when Rows comes from another module and names a type that module imports.

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.139 (breaking)
entry.summary: Reading a member off an Option or a Result is now checked.

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.138 (breaking)
entry.summary: Two ways for glyph fmt to change what a program means are fixed, and the fuzzer now checks for that directly.

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.137 (breaking)
entry.summary: glyph fmt no longer moves a comment.

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.136
entry.summary: glyph fmt keeps a comment written between the steps of a method chain.

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.135 (breaking)
entry.summary: JSX text is read as text.

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.134
entry.summary: This release changes how the parser reads a file and nothing about what a program means.

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.133 (breaking)
entry.summary: This release finishes what 0.1.132 started on json.parse: it never casts now, however it is spelled or reached.
